data.title: 红月卡莲 · 露天咖啡厅的战后晴空
data.description: 阳光明媚的步行街露天咖啡座前，卡莲脱下皮夹克搭在椅背，双手捧着冰饮仰望晴空白云，享受着得来不易的和平时光。
data.action: holding iced glass, gazing up at blue sky, peaceful relaxed smile
data.lighting: bright clean midday sunlight filtering through cafe canopy
data.promptProse: At an open-air cafe under a white parasol on a clear afternoon, Kallen Kouzuki smiles softly as she looks up toward the tranquil blue sky holding an iced drink.
data.animaCaption: Kallen enjoying a peaceful sunny afternoon at an outdoor cafe.
